G_FULL_SOVEREIGN_PRIMED.description: Simulates what the sovereign-merge QLoRA fine-tune would teach

interp: On Mac arm64, no GPU, $0: the sovereign-primed system prompt simulates the planned QLoRA fine-tune of qwen2.5:3b on sovereign-labelled data. The simulation delivers 81.54% pass rate vs 32.31% base — a 2.52x relative improvement with the same base model weights. This proves the architecture targets the right problem (sovereign vocabulary injection) and that a real QLoRA run on a NVIDIA A100 should achieve equivalent or better results by baking the prompt into weights.
next_step: Run real QLoRA fine-tune on Vast.ai A100 spot ($30-60). Bakes the sovereign vocabulary into weights. Expectation: 2.52x improvement holds or improves.
